title: Slides Mode
description: A single-presentation demo capsule that shows only the desktop Slides deck.

cards.title: Slides mode
cards.body: A one-screen-at-a-time deck, built for a desktop window or a phone held sideways.

cards.title: Click or arrow
cards.body: Advance with the on-screen arrows, the keyboard arrow keys, space, or a swipe.

cards.title: Made for wide
cards.body: Each slide fills the screen. On a phone, turn to landscape to give the deck room to breathe.

cards.title: One source
cards.body: These slides are generated from the same cards a story or reader would use. One source, many surfaces.

cards.title: That's slides
cards.body: Five slides, one sealed capsule. Use the gear to head back to the vault.
